summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Shareable Score Card feature on /property-passport/AMASS-LAG-00000233 (anon). All 5 acceptance criteria pass: btn-share-score renders visibly next to expand-chevron; the offscreen ShareableScoreCard is present in the DOM exactly once with computed left ~ -9976 (parent at -10000 + 24 inner offset — off-screen as intended); shareable card text content includes AMASS-LAG-00000233, Duplex, address 'Admiralty Way, Lekki Phase 1, Lekki, Lagos', score 5, '/ 100', UNVERIFIED tier pill, 'AI ESTIMATED VALUE', 'Awaiting comparable listings', 'Every listing is title-checked on AMASS', and 'amass.africa'; tapping the share button did not crash the app (no red screen, passport-screen still alive) — on web Sharing.isAvailableAsync() is false so the Share.share fallback path is invoked (or silently swallowed); existing PropertyScoreCard interactive UI unchanged (tier-pill, ai-value-fallback, score-gauge-num=5, breakdown-* rows = 6 when expanded); PropertyTypeChip passport-type-chip still visible and passport title block intact.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated `pointerEvents="none"` prop instead of `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}`. RN Web logs a deprecation warning. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/PropertyScoreCard.tsx:253

'shadow*' style props are deprecated in RN Web — logged as console warning. Not a new regression from this feature, but present in the score card render path. Reference: shared theme util (shadows.soft used in PropertyScoreCard.tsx:135)

action_items: (Low priority) Replace deprecated `pointerEvents="none"` prop with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` on the offscreen wrapper View in PropertyScoreCard.tsx to silence RN Web warning.
(Optional) Consider migrating shadow* style props to the newer `boxShadow` per RN Web recommendation (repo-wide, out of scope for this feature).
critical_code_review_comments: captureRef in onShare will silently fail on web if `shareRef` is measured before layout — the 300 ms pre-capture delay mitigates this. Good defensive coding.
Sharing.shareAsync fallback chain (Sharing → Share.share on web → MediaLibrary.saveToLibraryAsync on native) is properly guarded and does not throw when unsupported.
Offscreen wrapper uses position:absolute + opacity:0 + collapsable=false + pointerEvents=none — correct pattern for view-shot capture without visual/interaction bleed.
